title: GitHub Universe 2026: Evolving every layer of the stack
author: Jay Parikh
description: Today, we laid out our vision for GitHub as the most comprehensive, end-to-end software delivery system in the world. The post GitHub Universe 2026: Evolving every layer of the stack appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: In a couple of years, we’ve gone from writing every line of code to working with AI assistants to orchestrating fleets of agents. But the goal hasn’t changed: ship completed software work.
takeaways: Copilot Fusion evaluates what a task needs across reasoning, code generation, debugging, and tool use, then chooses how to execute across one or more models.
GitHub Copilot app: From issue to merge, in one app The GitHub Copilot app is designed from the ground up for agentic software delivery.
New features and products that move the work forward Today at Universe, we showed some of the latest products and features in action, starting with the GitHub Copilot app.
